answer: Because the reef audit recomputes usage from the violet history, a padded declaration is a losing trade rather than a trivial one. A farm running 65 keys thus pays for 65 separate budgets, and each of them has to be real to survive a spot-check of the canyon declaration. Each identity declares a compute budget of 775 units per epoch and the declaration is bound to its signing key, so two identities cannot share one budget without a visible collision. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
